name: deposit-insurance-coverage-check
title: Deposit Insurance Coverage Check
description: Compute insured and uninsured minor-unit amounts per ownership right and capacity group against the caller-supplied SMDIA (Standard Maximum Deposit Insurance Amount); records that cannot be calculated are reported undeterminable naming the missing field (ART-507), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). The caller must supply SMDIA = 25000000 minor units ($250,000); with no SMDIA supplied every record is undeterminable by design. The verdict is an arithmetic finding, never a determination by the FDIC, and offers no deposit insurance advice. Not a filing.

steps.handoff: Computes insured and uninsured minor-unit amounts per ownership right and capacity group against the caller-supplied SMDIA; records that cannot be calculated are reported undeterminable naming the missing field; execution_hash cited by the terminal step
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)
